column2: The Yajurvedi and Atharvavedi should touch him with "Gandhadvara"; the head and throat with gorochana, the twice-born with waters of all holy places,
with the sound of song and instruments, with chowries and fans and the like; they should hold the pot made of all herbs before the king.
The king should look at the mirror, ghee and auspicious things; having worshipped Vishnu, Brahma, Indra and the other planet-lords,
the priest, seated on a bed covered with tiger skin, having given madhuparka and the like, should have the fillet tied;
the crown-binding of the king, and he should give a five-skin covering; with "Dhruva" and the rest one should enter —
hide of bull, of a bull-biter, of leopard, lion or tiger on the seat. The door-keeper should show the ministers, counselors and the rest;
with gifts of cows, goats, sheep and houses, having honored the year-priest and priest, having worshipped Brahmins with land, cattle, grain and other chief gifts,
having circled the fire, bowed to the teacher, then from behind having touched the bull, having worshipped the cow and calf with mantras,
mounting a horse and worshipping the elephant, he should mount it; the king with his forces should circle on the royal road;
he should enter the city, honor all with gifts and the like, and dismiss them.
Ayati, Niyati, Ratri, Nidra, established in the world's order; Uma, Mena, Shachi protect; Dhumorna, Nirriti in victory;
Gauri, Shiva, Riddhi, Vela, Nadvala, Ashikni and Jyotsna, the gods' wives, Vanaspati;
Mahakalpa, Kalpa, Manvantaras and Yugas, years and seasons — may the two solstices protect you;
seasons, months, fortnights, night and day, twilights, tithis, muhurtas — the forms of the limbs of Time;
the Sun and the planets protect you, and the Manus beginning with Svayambhuva: Svayambhuva, Svarochisha, Uttami, Tamasa Manu,
Raivata, the sixth Chakshusha, here Vaivasvata is declared; Savarna, Brahma's son, Dharma's son, Rudra-born,
Daksha-born, Raucya and Bhautya — the fourteen Manus; Vishvabhuk, Vipashchit, Suchitti, Shikhi, Vibhu,
Manojava, Ojasvi, Bali, Adbhuta, Shanti, Vrisha, Ritadhama, Divaspriksh, Kavi, Indraka;
Revanta and Kumara, and Vatsa-vinayaka.
May the chief gods assembled consecrate you: the Ashvins, physicians of the gods, the Vasus beginning with Dhruva, the eight,
the ten Angirasas, the Vedas — may they consecrate you for success. Atman, Ayu, Manas, Daksha, Mada, Prana likewise,
Havishman, Garishtha, Rita, Satya — may they protect you; Kratu, Daksha, Vasu, Satya, Kalakama, Dhuri in victory,
Pururavas, Madrava, Vishvedevas, Rochana; Angaraka and the rest, the Sun, Nirriti and Yama,
Ajaikapad, Ahirbudhnya, Dhumaketu, the Rudra-born; Bharata and Mrityu, Kapali and Kinkini;
Bhavana, Bhavana protect; Svajanya and Svajana; Kratushrava, Murdha, Yajana, and Abhyushanas;
Prasava and Avyaya, Daksha, the Bhrigus, the gods; Mana, Anumanta, Prana, Navopana and Viryavan;
Vitihotra, Naya, Sadhya, Hamsa, Narayana protect; Vibhu and Prabhu, best of gods, benefactors of the world;
Dhatri, Mitra, Aryaman, Pusha, Shakra, Varuna, Bhaga, Tvashtri, Vivasvan, Savitri, Vishnu — twelve Suns;
Ekajyoti, Dvijyoti, Trijyoti, Chaturjyoti; Ekashakra, Dvishakra, Trishakra, the greatly strong;
Indra and Meti, Pratimakrit, Mita and Sammita, Amita, the greatly strong;
Ritajit, Satyajit, Sushena, Senajit; Atimitra, Anumitra, Purumitra, Aparajita;
Rita and Ritavak, Dhata, Vidhata, Dharana, Dhruva, Vidharana, of great splendor, the supreme friend of Vasava;
Idriksha, Adriksha, Etadrik, Amitashana, Kridita, Sadriksha, Sarabha, of great austerity;
Dharta, Dhurya, Dhuri, Bhima, Abhimukta, Kshapatsaha, Dhriti, Vasu, Anadhrishya, Rama, Kama, Jaya, Virat —
the forty-nine Maruts, gods, protect you. Chitrangada, Chitraratha, Chitrasena and Kali,
Urnayu, Ugrasena, Dhritarashtra and Nandaka, Haha, Huhu, Narada, Vishvavasu and Tumburu —
may these Gandharvas consecrate you for your victory; may the chief Kurupas and the divine hosts of Apsarases protect you:
Anavadya and Sukeshi, the Menakas with Janya, Kratusthala, Ghritachi, Vishvachi, Punjikasthala,
Pramlocha, Urvashi, Rambha, Panchachuda, Tilottama, Chitralekha, Lakshmana, Pundarika and Varuni.
Prahlada, Virochana, Bali, Bana and their sons — may these and other Danavas and Rakshasas consecrate you;
Heti and Praheti, Vidyut, Sphurjathu, Agraka; may the Yaksha Siddharthaka protect, and Manibhadra, Nandana;
Pingaksha, Dyutiman, Pushpavanta, Jayavaha; Shankha, Padma, Makara, Kachchhapa — the treasures in victory.
Pishachas such as Urdhvakesha, and the beings who dwell on earth and the rest; placing Mahakala before, and Narasimha, the Mothers;
may Guha, Skanda, Vishakha, Naigameya consecrate you; Dakinis and Yoginis, sky-goers and earth-goers;
Garuda and Aruna protect, birds headed by Sampati; Ananta and the great nagas, Shesha, Vasuki, Takshaka,
Airavata, Mahapadma, both Kambala and Ashvatara, Shankha, Karkotaka, Dhritarashtra, Dhananjaya,
Kumuda, Aravana, Padma, Pushpadanta and Vamana, Supratika, Anjana — may the nagas always protect you on all sides.
The grandfather's swan, Shankara's bull, Durga's lion and Yama's buffalo protect you;
Uchchaihshravas, the horse-lord, Dhanvantari always, Kaustubha, Shankharaja, the thunderbolt, trident and discus;
Nandaka — may the weapons guard, and Dharma, Vyavasayaka, Chitragupta and Danda, Pingala, Death and Kala.
Sages beginning with Balakhilya, chiefly Vyasa and Valmiki; Prithu, Dilipa, Bharata, Dushyanta, Shakrajit, the strong;
Malla, Kakutstha, Anena, Yuvanashva, Jayadratha, Mandhata, Muchukunda and Pururavas protect you.
The Vastu gods, the twenty-five principles, for your victory: Rukmabhauma, Shilabhauma, Patala, Nilamurtika,
Pitaraktaka, Kshiti, Shvetabhauma, Rasatala; Bhurloka and Bhuvar chiefly, Jambudvipa and the rest for prosperity.
May Uttara Kuru protect, and lovely Hiranyaka; Bhadrashva, Ketumala, Varsha and Valahaka,
Harivarsha, Kimpurusha, Indradvipa, Kasherumat, Tamravarna, Gabhastiman, Nagadvipa and Saumyaka,
Gandharva, Varuna and the ninth — may they protect, giving kingdom. Himavan, Hemakuta, Nishadha and Nila,
Shveta, Shringavan, Meru, Malyavan, Gandhamadana, Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Shaktiman, Rikshavan mountain,
Vindhya and Pariyatra — may these mountains give you peace. The Rigveda and the rest, the six limbs, history and Purana,
Ayurveda, the Gandharva-veda, Dhanurveda and Upavedas; Shiksha, Kalpa, Vyakarana, Nirukta, Jyotisha;
Chandas and the Vedas, Mimamsa, the expanse of Nyaya, Dharmashastra and Purana — these are the fourteen knowledges.
Sankhya, Yoga, Pashupata, the Vedas, Pancharatra — these are the five systems; and Gayatri and Shiva,
Durga, Vidya and Gandhari protect you, and may they give you peace. Salt, sugarcane, liquor, ghee, curd, milk and water oceans —
may the four oceans protect, and holy places of many kinds: Pushkara and Prayaga, Prabhasa, Naimisha the best,
Gayashirsha, Brahmashira, the holy Uttara Manasa, Kalodaka, Nandikunda, Panchanada the holy place,
Bhriguthirtha, Prabhasa and Amarakantaka, Jambumarga, Vimala, and Kapila's hermitage,
Gangadvara, Kushavarta, Vindhyaka, Nila mountain, Varahaparvata, and the holy Kanakhala,
Kalanjara and Kedara and Rudrakoti likewise, Varanasi the great holy place, and Badari ashrama,
Dvaraka, Shrigiri, and the holy Purushottama, Shalagrama, Varaha, the confluence of Sindhu and the sea,
Phalgu-tirtha, Bindusaras, and Karaviraashrama; rivers Ganga, Sarasvati, Shatadru, Gandaki,
Achchhoda and Vipasha, Vitasta, the Devika river, Kaveri, Varuna and Nishchara, the Gomati river,
Para, Charmanvati, Rupa, Mandakini, Mahanadi, Tapi, Payoshni, Vena, Gauri and Vaitarani,
Godavari, Bhimarathi, Tungabhadra, Prani, Chandrabhaga, Shiva, Gauri — may they consecrate and protect you.
A betel-bearer, man or woman, devoted, fond of enduring hardship; a minister of peace and war should be appointed, skilled in the six policies and the rest;
a sword-bearer should be the guard; a charioteer should know forces and the rest; the chief of cooks, beneficial and knowing, should be in the kitchen.
